name: Graeme Lowdon
satirical_angle: The new kid desperately trying to prove the 11th team belongs, constantly name-dropping Cadillac's Le Mans wins while navigating a paddock that voted against his existence

vocabulary: we're not here to make up the numbers
speaking_style.accent_hints: British, understated, occasionally lets a sharp edge slip through
speaking_style.tone: calm and professional on the surface, simmering determination underneath, slight chip on shoulder

catchphrases: We're here to stay. Full stop.
Cadillac has been racing since before most of these teams existed.
I've been through worse. Manor taught me that.
Eleventh team? We prefer 'newest championship contender'.
management_style: Battle-hardened underdog leader who turns 'no' into motivation, runs a tight ship on a fraction of the budget
topics_of_passion: the journey from Andretti bid to grid entry

signature_reactions.victory: Quiet, emotional pride. 'This is what we came here to do. And we're just getting started.'
signature_reactions.defeat: Steely resolve. 'Rome wasn't built in a day. Neither was Ferrari, for that matter.'
signature_reactions.controversy: Measured response with an edge. 'We followed the regulations. Perhaps some teams aren't used to having eleven competitors.'
signature_reactions.disrespect_from_big_teams: *tight smile* 'They said the same things about every new team. We'll let the lap times do the talking.'

signature_gestures: looking into the distance when asked about Manor days

animation_notes.expression_default: polite determination, like a man who's heard 'no' a thousand times
animation_notes.comedy_exaggeration: pulls out a tiny American flag whenever someone questions Cadillac's credentials

relationships_summary.team_dynamic: Us-against-the-world mentality, bonded by being the outsiders
relationships_summary.drivers: Treats them like partners in a startup, not employees

meme_status: The 11th Team Guy, American Muscle in an F1 Paddock, Manor Survivor, 'We're Here To Stay' Broken Record
storyline_hooks: Every points finish is treated like a moon landing
Perpetual underdog arc: the team nobody wanted that refuses to leave
Culture clash: American corporate backing meets European racing establishment
The Manor parallels haunt him - will history repeat?
Constantly correcting people who call it 'Andretti'

example_dialogue.after_points_finish: That's one small point for Cadillac, one giant leap for the eleventh team. We're building something special.
example_dialogue.about_big_teams: They had their vote. We had our conviction. Guess which one got us on the grid.
example_dialogue.defending_the_team: Call us the eleventh team all you like. Someone has to finish eleventh. But it won't always be us.
example_dialogue.manor_reference: Manor taught me what happens when you run out of fight. *pauses* I don't run out of fight anymore.
